author: Bekarys Uzbekbayev
primary_research_question: To what extent do different document chunking strategies (fixed-size, fixed-size with overlap, and semantic chunking) affect the preservation of context and the accuracy of answers generated by RAG systems?

hypotheses.H1: Chunking strategy has an effect on recall@k (the three strategies do not all give the same recall@k).
hypotheses.H2: Fixed-size chunking with overlap gives higher recall@k than fixed-size chunking without overlap, because overlap keeps text that would otherwise be cut at chunk boundaries.
hypotheses.H3: Higher recall@k is associated with higher answer accuracy across the three strategies.

primary_metric.name: answer_span_hit_at_3
primary_metric.definition: At least one top-3 chunk from the correct article completely contains at least one annotated answer span, before prompt packing.
primary_metric.interpretation: Answer-span coverage proxy, not recall over all relevant passages or full semantic context preservation.

secondary_metrics.scoring: Original SQuAD 1.1 normalization and independent maximum over all references for EM and token-multiset F1; each question receives one score.
secondary_metrics.corpus_answer_span_coverage_definition: For each question, any chunk from the correct article fully contains an annotated answer span, before top-k selection.
secondary_metrics.visible_evidence_hit_definition: The same single-fragment complete annotated-span rule applied after prompt packing; it is a conservative coverage proxy.

confidence_intervals.scope: Evaluation article and question variation conditional on the fixed corpus and models; bootstrap resamples existing results and does not rebuild indexes or rerun models.

omnibus.name: article_blocked_method_label_permutation
omnibus.null_scheme: Independently permute the three method labels within each article; keep all question results inside their article.

primary_tests.pairwise_scheme: Random sign flips of the 20 article-level paired mean differences; statistic is the absolute overall paired mean difference.
primary_tests.assumptions: Method-label exchangeability within article under the null; paired sign-flips require pair exchangeability or symmetric null differences. Deterministic algorithms do not create randomized assignment.

hypothesis_decisions.H2_support: Adjusted omnibus p < 0.05, adjusted overlap-minus-fixed pair p < 0.05, and observed overlap-minus-fixed difference > 0.
hypothesis_decisions.H1_H2_otherwise: No detected support or inconclusive; do not claim equivalence or acceptance of a null hypothesis.

H3_exploratory.estimand: Pooled mean F1 among hit records minus pooled mean F1 among miss records.
H3_exploratory.bootstrap: Resample whole articles and recompute the two pooled conditional means in every draw; do not average article-specific contrasts.
H3_exploratory.support_language: Consistent with H3, exploratory: positive pooled contrast, wholly positive CI, adequacy rules satisfied, and all three within-method contrasts estimable and positive.
H3_exploratory.otherwise: Inconclusive, heterogeneous, or not supported; nonestimable groups do not establish a null relationship.
H3_exploratory.sensitivity: Repeat descriptively using visible evidence hit, and report EM conditional means; do not replace the prespecified raw-hit F1 result with a more favorable sensitivity.
H3_exploratory.limitations: Association may reflect question difficulty, topic and method composition; it is not a causal effect of improving retrieval.

error_analysis.failure_definition: At least one method has exact_match < 1 for a generation question.
error_analysis.category_rates_denominator: Report selected questions, reviewed strategy records and failed records separately; category proportions describe the reviewed failures only.

additional_analysis.subgroups: All 20 articles; 100 retrieval and 50 generation questions per article per method.
additional_analysis.runtime_scope: Single local CPU run. Retrieval chunking includes semantic-unit encoding; query encoding/model loading reported separately. Answer pipeline includes packing, tokenization, generation, decoding and scoring. Descriptive hardware-specific timing, not a universal benchmark.
figures: Generation EM and F1 with article-cluster intervals
additional_analysis.independent_reproduction: A classmate will use a clean environment and a declared subset containing the first generation ID in each article; actual environment, commands, outcomes and confirmation go to Appendix C.

failures_and_deviations.execution_errors: Retain failed/interrupted artifacts; resume only under unchanged frozen inputs and provenance.
failures_and_deviations.method_changes: Document deviations explicitly; obtain required instructor approval for changes to RQ, aim, objectives or design.
